message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is the exact description of the UI elements and the identification of the round element:

**UI Elements Visible:**
*   **Main Content Area (Black Background):**
    *   **Top:** An orange diagonal line in the upper left corner.
    *   **Center-Top:** The word "**STRAVA**" in large, bold, white, sans-serif capital letters.
    *   **Middle:** Three columns of white text representing activity statistics:
        *   Left: "**Distance**" (label) above "**1.63 km**" (value).
        *   Center: "**Pace**" (label) above "**20:00 /km**" (value).
        *   Right: "**Time**" (label) above "**32:35**" (value).
    *   **Lower-Center:** A white line-art icon of a running shoe.
    *   **Bottom:** The text "**Transparent background — shown on dark**" in a smaller, grey/white font.
*   **Bottom-Left Corner:**
    *   A **dark grey rounded square or circle** containing a white capital letter "**N**". This element overlaps the edge of the black content area and sits on top of a faint grid pattern visible in the margin.

**Identification of the Round Element with 'N':**
This is a **map compass control** (specifically, a North indicator). In mapping applications like Strava, Google Maps, or Apple Maps, this button is used to orient the map so that North is pointing up. The "N" stands for North.

**Text Near It:**
The text located directly above and to the right of this compass control is:
> **"Transparent background — shown on dark"**
